description: Passing results require a verified pipeline and paired final answers; headline savings use final-answer input tokens only for quality-passing runs.

assertion_evidence_support.description: Assertions with a citation and material evidence IDs, distinct from containment.

lexical_identifier_support.description: Assertions with lexical or identifier support in cited material, distinct from semantic grounding.

citation_containment.description: Citation range is contained in supplied material; this is not semantic support.

SemanticCoverage.description: Completeness of requested enrichment, independently of provider errors.

RealBenchmarkPhaseUsage.description: Actual attempts retained even when a paired evaluation fails midway.
